# Version 3.119.2
> **Native hardening release** · Released February 6, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.119.2) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v3.119.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.119.2/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.1.3/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.119.2 adds platform API coverage and hardens the shipped native binaries. This servicing release restores missing tvOS surface overloads, preserves Android symbols, and enables modern Windows and Linux binary mitigations.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## API Surface

- **Missing tvOS SKSurface.Create overloads added** — tvOS applications can use the same SKSurface.Create overload coverage as the related Apple targets. — ❤️ [@MartinZikmund](https://github.com/MartinZikmund) ([#3342](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3342))

## Platform

- **Android symbols preserved in packages** — Android native symbols are retained and packaged for improved diagnostics of native crashes. ([#3374](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3374))

## Security

- **Native DLL mitigations enabled** — Windows and Linux native libraries are built with additional control-flow and buffer-protection mitigations. — ❤️ [@Aguilex](https://github.com/Aguilex) ([#3397](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3397), [#3404](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3404), [#3497](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3497), [#3503](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3503))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.3

Ships the synchronized HarfBuzzSharp package with the native binary hardening and Android symbol packaging updates.
